+permissions:
+  contents: read

+  group: splitzero-boundary-recovery-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true

+  verify:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 35
+    env:
+      LEAN_NUM_THREADS: 2
+    defaults:
+      run:
+        working-directory: formal/splitzero
+        shell: bash
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - name: Recover unchanged scalar
+        run: python3 prepare.py
+      - name: Install unchanged Lean toolchain
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail

+          echo "$HOME/.elan/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
+      - name: Retrieve pinned Mathlib and build original library
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          lake update
+          test "$(git -C .lake/packages/mathlib rev-parse HEAD)" = fabf563a7c95a166b8d7b6efca11c8b4dc9d911f
+          lake exe cache get
+          lake build
+      - name: Construct and strictly check the retained boundary kernel
+        run: python3 ../../workbenches/tau-mixed-boundary-formal/run_boundary.py
+      - name: Strict recovered closure and all selected audits
+        run: python3 ../../workbenches/tau-mixed-metric-integration/run_mixed.py

+          python3 check_derived.py --prepare

+        run: |

+          lake env lean --version
+          cat .mixed-metric-logs/receipt.json
+          cat .boundary-socle-logs/joint.json

+    timeout-minutes: 20

+import SplitZeroInternalQuotient
+
+/-!
+# Retained boundary socle, not ordinary specialization
+
+For an injective f and an injective scalar v, the actual quotient by range(v*f)
+has v-kernel isomorphic to M/vM, via [x] -> [f x]. The map and inverse laws are
+constructed before any arithmetic or inertia observation. This specializes to
+D_v/v with exponents b, or k+sum(b)-1 on an ordered tensor boundary.
+-/
+noncomputable section
+namespace SplitZero.BoundarySocle
+open SplitZero.Reconstruction
+variable {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
+
+def scalarMap (v : R) : M →ₗ[R] M := v • LinearMap.id
+
+def sourceRel (v : R) : Submodule R M := LinearMap.range (scalarMap (M := M) v)
+def targetRel (v : R) (f : M →ₗ[R] M) : Submodule R M := LinearMap.range (v • f)
+
+/-- The actual map from the source specialization to the retained cokernel. -/
+def comparison (v : R) (f : M →ₗ[R] M) :

+/-- A block of the log series, with every denominator retained. -/
+def block (s : ℕ → ℝ) (start len : ℕ) : ℝ :=

+  block hi 0 p + block hi p p / (1-hi p)

+    block s 0 (2*p) = block s 0 p + block s p p := by
+  rw [show 2*p = p+p by omega]
+  unfold block
+  rw [Finset.sum_range_add]
+  simp only [zero_add]

+    (hA : ∀ a, A a = (c : ℂ) • (1-H a))
+    (w : ∀ a, ArithmeticLogTransfer.LossWitness (H a))
+    (p : Fin 4 → ℕ) (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a)
+    (lo hi : Fin 4 → ℕ → ℝ)
+    (hlo : ∀ a n, 1 ≤ n → n ≤ 2*p a → lo a n ≤ RestrictionSpectrum.moment (H a) n)

+    ArithmeticLogTransfer.signedLog A ≤ -η :=

+
+theorem frame_smul (c : ℝ) (A : Matrix j j ℂ) :
